gaps.title: Analytic transform transfer
gaps.detail: Exact LDL positivity applies to decimal-rational transform vectors and matrices, not interval-enclosed Fourier integrals.
gaps.next_action: Interval-enclose the basis integrals and propagate entrywise errors to a PSD margin.

gaps.title: Theorem-backed zero-count coefficient
gaps.detail: The A1 coefficient is an inherited floating profile rounded downward, not a cited theorem object packaged with hypotheses.
gaps.next_action: Replace it by an explicit zero-count theorem evaluated with directed rounding.

gaps.title: Theorem-backed tail matrix
gaps.detail: The tail multiplier and t^-4 density profile remain a floating prototype.
gaps.next_action: Derive and interval-evaluate a tail inequality with explicit constants.

gaps.title: Function-class scope
gaps.detail: The rejection covers the R=3, 24-bump, 22-dimensional finite class, not arbitrary compactly supported admissible test functions.
gaps.next_action: Map dual lower bounds over support radius, basis density, and dictionary geometry.

gaps.title: Support versus prime-side feasibility
gaps.detail: Larger support weakens the sampled obstruction but raises the prime cutoff proxy exponentially.
gaps.next_action: Build RH_Support_Prime_Dual_Frontier_v0.4 with dual-gated primal and prime-side cost models.

gaps.title: Axis-only near-null geometry
gaps.detail: At rho=0 the smallest eigenvalues range from about -1.1e-6 to numerical zero.
gaps.next_action: Use high precision or interval inertia checks to decide whether pure A1 positivity is truly false.

gaps.title: Full-patch feasibility at larger support
gaps.detail: Center-only dual escape does not construct a candidate negative on the whole patch.
gaps.next_action: After dual gating, run multi-point patch constraints and continuity audits.

gaps.title: Unknown off-axis regions
gaps.detail: The complete zero-side sign and leakage budget is not included.
gaps.next_action: Partition and certify every remaining orbit-type region.

gaps.title: Zero presence and winding
gaps.detail: No argument-principle certificate establishes a zero in a target patch.
gaps.next_action: Attach validated winding objects only after a viable global budget exists.

gaps.title: Local-to-global closure
gaps.detail: No complete formal implication from local patch objects to an RH contradiction is present.
gaps.next_action: Close all quantifiers and theorem dependencies in a proof-assistant or independently checked claim graph.
